before_times: What should be done? (take down, prune, grind a stump, storm damage)
Is any part of the tree within 10 feet of a power line? (no; only the line to the house; street lines)
About how tall is the tree, and how wide is the trunk?
Is it leaning, cracked or dead?
after_time: Whose tree is it? (yours; on the property line; someone else's)
Is it on the city strip by the street?
How wide is the gate to the yard? Any pets?
The wood and the stump: hauled away or left; ground or left
Will you be home for the arborist visit? (not needed)
secure_page_only: Private buried lines near the stump (sprinklers, a dog fence, yard lights)
intake_questions.who_may_book: An adult who owns the tree. A tree on the property line needs the neighbor's yes too, given on the secure page. Someone else's tree, or a renter's, is booked or OK'd by its owner.

stop.words: a limb or tree on a power line, wires down, sparks, a tree touching the street lines
stop.says: Stay far away, and keep everyone back. Call 911 and the electric company. Only the utility or a line-clearance crew may work on it.

stop.words: someone hurt or trapped, a gas smell after a tree fell
stop.says: Call 911 now, and leave the area if you smell gas.

go_on.words: a tree or a big limb on the house or the garage
go_on.says: Get everyone out of the rooms under it, and keep them out. Don't go on the roof or cut anything. Call 911 first if anyone is hurt, wires are down or you smell gas.
go_on.booking: goes on, marked urgent; sent now where the business takes storm work

go_on.words: a tree leaning more, or a new crack at the base
go_on.says: Keep people and cars away from the side it leans toward.
go_on.booking: goes on; the soonest time is offered

go_on.words: a gas line marked near a stump
go_on.says: Nobody grinds inside the marked zone.
go_on.booking: the grinding stops there; a partial grind or none, with Alex's yes

safety_and_stop_words.business_line: Questions about whether a tree is safe to climb or cut yourself go to the business's own line

prep: Mark any private buried lines near the stump (sprinklers, a dog fence, yard lights): 811 marks only the utilities' lines
Move cars away from the tree and the drop zone the night before
Unlock the gate, and keep pets inside

staff.who_oks: Sam OKs quotes, change orders and job days over $500; Pat may OK them too, and Sam's answer wins
staff.stand_in: Hugo may take an arborist visit for a stump or pruning; a removal keeps its arborist unless Sam moves it
staff.roles: Eli: the arborist, who does arborist visits and quotes and leads the crew. Hugo: crew lead, stumps and storm work on call. Nell and Wes at the yard; only Nell runs the sawmill and the log splitter.

children_and_age.who_may_book: An adult who owns the tree. A tree on the property line needs the neighbor's yes too, given on the secure page. Someone else's tree, or a renter's, is booked or OK'd by its owner.
children_and_age.minors_texts: Never booked by a minor; a child at home is never the one who walks the job with the crew

visit.check_in: The arborist visit and each job day: the check-in code at the door or the gate, or DONE with a photo when nobody is home. The yard: the code at the yard office.
visit.done: The walk-through against the quote, line by line; ruts from the lift leveled and seeded before leaving; then DONE
visit.changes_at_visit: Extra work (another tree, a dead limb) is priced and OK'd in writing before it's done. Less work (a partial grind by a gas line) is priced down, with the customer's yes.
